body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Ecosol Solar Technologies unveiled the state of the art USB-powered portable charger 'Powerstick V2' for mobile devices at 2009 CES.

The Powerstick is both a backup power source for electronics, such as cell phones, Blackberries, iPods, digital cameras, Bluetooth headsets, new 3G iPhones, and a universal charger for all these devices.
